# Binly kit — full API reference (generated by tools/kitdoc.mjs from docs/kit/*.md)
Prefer docs/KIT-INDEX.md + the 1–3 sections you need. Visual catalogs: docs/catalog/templates.png, docs/catalog/kit.png.

## Core — stage, camera, time, shots (`kit/stage`, `kit/anim`, `kit/shots`, `kit/theme`)

**theme** — `C` palette (paper, paperLight/Shade/Deep/Dark, ink, inkSoft/Lift/Mute/Faint, oxblood, oxLight/oxTint/oxDeep,
evidence(+Light/Tint), theory(+Light/Tint), caution(+Light/Tint), bone, wood/woodDark/woodLight, stone/stoneShade/stoneDark,
metal, lamp, fire, water/waterDeep, slate, sky, dusk, night, skin[0..4], skinShade[0..4], hair[0..4], strata[0..6]),
`SEM` (confirmed|evidence|theory|speculation|caution|debated|signal|ink → colour), `FONT_SERIF`, `FONT_SANS`, `W`=1920, `H`=1080, `SAFE`=96,
`lang` (kit/lang): `isAr()`, `lang()`, `word('vs'|'VS'|'but')` (kit-written words), `FONT_AR`. Set per render from
video.json → Stage applies Arabic fonts + RTL mirroring; `className="k-nomirror"` keeps a group's real geometry.
`GLOW` = {soft, gold, lavender, green, oxblood, white} filter urls (defined in every Stage) + `glowFor(color)` — elegant
soft halos: `<g filter={GLOW.gold}>`. `C.gold` (key accent) · `C.goldLight` · `C.goldTint` · `C.lavender`. Paper = clean white.
`TYPE` = {key 72 · read 48 · label 40 (all-caps sans) · small 36 · credit 26} — phone-readable text sizes (never go below them;
kit Kicker/Tag/LabelPlate/chart labels enforce the floor). Keep important text above y = 970 (YouTube player controls).

**anim** (pure functions of t):
- `ramp(t,a,b,fn=ease.inOut)` 0→1 · `unramp` 1→0 · `keys(t,[[t,v],…],fn)` · `win(t,a,b,fi=.4,fo=.4)` fade window
- `stagger(t,start,i,gap,dur,fn)` · `drift(t,period,amp,phase)` · `noise1(x,seed)` ∈[-1,1] · `rand(seed)` ∈[0,1) · `randRange(seed,lo,hi)`
- `ease.{linear,inOut,out,in,outQuint,inOutQuint,inOutSine,outSine,outBack,outElastic}` · `lerp` · `clamp01` · `mixHex(a,b,k)`
- `camAt(t, [[time,cx,cy,zoom,rotDeg?],…])` → CamState (log-space zoom) · `typeOn(t,a,text,cps)` · `countUp(value,p)` (exact landing)

**motion** (kit/motion — the channel's pop-up-and-bounce vocabulary; every preset also cues its own sound):
- `spring(x, bounce=0.35)` damped spring 0→1 (overshoot, soft exact landing) · `popIn(p, bounce, from)` → {s, sx, sy, o} jelly pop ·
  `bob(t, amp, period)` idle float. `ease.outBack` IS this spring now (every kit pop bounces).
- `<Enter kind p x y>` (p LINEAR 0→1; pivot x,y): pop · bounceDrop · backInUp/Down/Left/Right · jackInTheBox · flipIn ·
  zoomSpin · whipLeft/Right · stamp · rise. `<Attention kind t at x y>`: rubberBand · heartBeat · tada · wobble · shake ·
  pulse · jello · float. `<Exit kind p x y>`: popOut · shrink · flyUp · flyDown · fade. Headline `mode="bounce"` = words pop
  up one by one (kinetic type). Showcase: Gallery page "motion".

**stage**
- `<Stage bg={C.paper}>…svg children…</Stage>` full 1920×1080 frame (every shot/chapter renders one).
- **Steady text (rule):** Chrome snaps axis-aligned glyphs to whole pixels vertically, so under slow camera drifts text
  lags then jumps ~1 px against shapes. Stage fixes it globally with a constant, invisible 0.1° tilt on every `<text>`
  (without its own `transform` attribute) and every `<foreignObject className={TEXT_FO}>` (export of kit/stage; RichText,
  Para, Bubble use it) → glyphs land sub-pixel in both axes. Your own HTML text in a foreignObject: add
  `className={TEXT_FO}`. Never animate text with noise/wobble. Check: `node tools/jitter-test.mjs --kit`, or a real shot
  `--at <sec> --text x0,y0,x1,y1 --ref x0,y0,x1,y1` (ref = a solid shape on the same layer), or a cloud render `--mp4 file --at <sec>`.
- `<Cam cam={state} depth={1}>` camera group (depth<1 far/slow, >1 foreground). `<CamKeys t keys={[...]} depth>` shorthand.
- `<World cam={cam} layers={[{depth:0.3, el:<Far/>},{depth:1, el:<Main/>},{depth:1.4, el:<Front/>}]}/>` parallax.
- `breathe(cam,t,amount=1)` subtle handheld life for holds (translation only — never add micro rotation/zoom noise on text: it shimmers) · `shake(cam,t,t0,strength=14,decay=5)` impacts.
- `<At x y s sx sy r o>` transform wrapper · `uid(...parts)` stable ids for clip paths.

**shots**
- `<Shots t shots={[{start, render:(t)=>el, in?:{kind,dur?,x?,y?,dir?,color?}}]}/>` sequence with transitions.
  kinds: `cut fade dip ink iris irisOut push paper zoom wipe` (x,y = focus point; dir = left|right|up|down).
- `<TransitionView tr p a b/>` low-level blend of two elements.

**video** — `ChapterDef {id,start,end,C,in?}` · `<Chapters t chapters/>` (generated `index.tsx` uses it).

---

## Text (`kit/text`) — p = reveal progress 0→1
- `Headline {x,y,text,p,size=72,color,anchor='middle',italic,weight=600,mode:'rise'|'words'|'type'|'mask',accent?:{word:colour},font:'serif'|'sans',out?}`
  e.g. `<Headline x={960} y={220} text="A hot bath was medicine." mode="words" accent={{medicine: C.oxblood}} p={ramp(t,T.a,T.a+1)}/>`
- `Kicker {x,y,text,p=1,size=36,color=inkMute,anchor}` tracked caps label (never below 36 — phone floor).
- `Para {x,y,w,h=600,text,p,size=48,color,align,font,weight,italic,lineHeight}` wrapped paragraph (keep short).
- `GlowPill {x,y,text,kind:Sem,p,size=44,to?,anchor}` THE channel label: rounded pill, heavy text, soft glow in its colour
  (ink = white pill, caution = gold, theory = lavender, confirmed = green, signal = oxblood). `Tag` defaults to it (look='pill').
- `Tag {x,y,text,kind:Sem,p,size=43 (caption text renders ×1.12 = 48; floor),to?:{x,y},anchor:'left'|'right'|'center',look:'caption'|'pill'}` certainty label.
  Default look 'caption' = museum caption (colour stripe + italic serif on a paper slip); 'pill' = old solid chip (legacy — don't use).
- Red-pen verdict (Binly's ONLY verdict style; for the climax use it at hero size — full-screen claim, big handwritten note): in templates `ClaimShot … stamp="Wrong"` (verdict 'pen' is default);
  in custom scenes `RichText … strike={ramp(t,T.x,T.x+0.5)}` crosses the words out exactly + a `HandNote` verdict;
  `RedPen {lines:[{x,y,w}],p,note,noteX,noteY,strike}` for SVG text whose line widths you know.
- `HandNote {x,y,text,p,size=50,color=oxblood,rot=-3,anchor,weight}` handwritten note (Caveat, `FONT_HAND`), written on
  letter by letter. RARE accent: a scribbled note beside a detail on an image/document (often with `Circled`/an arrow) —
  never titles, labels or body text; at most one or two per chapter.
- `Stat {x,y,value:'0.061',unit?:'%',label?,p,count=true,size=180,color,anchor}` exact number, counts up, lands exactly.
- `Underline {x,y,w,p,color,thick,wobble}` · `Highlight {x,y,w,h,p,color,opacity}` (draw BEFORE text) · `Circled {x,y,rx,ry?,p,color,thick,rot}`
- `NameTag {x,y,name,sub?,p,anchor:'left'|'right',color,dark}` real person / source label.
- `TitleCard {x,y,kicker?,title,p,out?,color,kickerColor,size=96}` chapter/section title.
- `textW(text,size,font,weight)` approximate width for layout.

## Cards & paper objects (`kit/cards`) — origin centre, p = entrance (rise+settle)
- `Card {x,y,w,h,p,rot,fill,stroke,radius,shadow,children}` children in card-local coords (0,0 top-left).
- `DocumentPage {x,y,s,p,rot,title?,subtitle?,lines=11,text?,highlight?:{line,p,color},seal,sealColor,signature,style:'parchment'|'modern'|'journal',write}` ≈560×740.
- `Polaroid {id,x,y,w=460,p,rot,imageBg,caption,children}` children inside square window (centre 0,0).
- `StudyCard {x,y,p,rot,title,who?,year?,finding?,n?,tag?:{text,kind},accent}` 760×460 research card.
- `Note {x,y,text,p,rot,color,w=340,h=300,size=42}` sticky note · `OpenBook {x,y,s,p,rot,cover,lines,leftTitle,rightTitle}` ≈640×420.
- `Screen {id,x,y,w=760,h=440,p,frame:'monitor'|'tablet'|'phone',bg,children}` children in screen coords (top-left 0,0).
- `ScreenText {x,y,text,p,t,size,color,cursor}` typewriter line for screens.
- `Bubble {x,y,w,h,text?,to?:{x,y},p,kind:'speech'|'thought'|'inner',fill,color,size,type}` — `inner` = dashed plum (silent inner voice).

## Diagrams (`kit/diagrams`) — p = draw-on
- `Arrow {from,to,p,bend=0,color,width=6,head=22,dashed,double,shorten}` (curved if bend≠0).
- `Node {x,y,text,p,w?,h=110,kind:Sem,filled,size,icon?}` labelled box.
- `FlowChain {x,y,items[],p,gap=140,dir:'row'|'column',kinds?:Sem[],size,nodeW}` sequential cause→effect.
- `Cycle {x,y,r,items[],p,spin,kinds,size}` · `Venn {x,y,r,labels[],overlap?,p,kinds,spread}`
- `Bracket {a,b,p,depth,label,color,size}` · `Callout {target,label,text,p,kind,size,anchor}` elbow leader label.
- `DashedOutline {d,p,color=theory,width,fill}` (= absent/inferred) · `CrossOut {x,y,size,p}` · `CheckMark {x,y,size,p}` · `QuestionMark {x,y,size,p,color,t}`

## Effects (`kit/fx`)
- `LightPool {x,y,r,color=lamp,strength,sy}` flat light · `LightShaft {x1,x2,y,dx,len,spread,color,strength}` window beam
- `GroundShadow {x,y,w,h?,o}` · `Vignette {strength,color}` · `Pulse {x,y,r,p,color}` one ring · `Beacon {x,y,r,t,period}` repeating
- `DrawPath {d,p,stroke,width,fill,dash,cap,o}` draw any path on · `Pop {x,y,p,from,r,children}` scale-in · `SlideIn {p,dx,dy,children}`
- `WipeReveal {id,x,y,w,h,p,dir,children}` · `Particles {t,x,y,w,h,n,seed,size,color,opacity,vx,vy,wobble,shape:'dot'|'ring'|'blob',twinkle}`
- `GlowBackdrop {t,id,x=960,y=560,tone:'gold'|'lavender'|'green'|'sky'|'warm',rays=16,spin=1,strength,stars=10,p,seed,r}`
  THE white-mode background: light pours out from behind the hero at (x,y). Draw it first.
- `GlowFloor {t,id,horizon=640,tone,drift=0,strength,stars,p,seed,vx}` "stage" background: glowing horizon line + perspective
  grid floor (things stand on it). `drift` px/s makes the floor travel toward the viewer.
- `SlamTitle {t,at,out?,text,tone:'red'|'gold'|'lavender'|'green',size?,sub?,wash=0.88,y}` giant one-word headline that
  slams toward the viewer (overshoot + impact shake, thick outline + glow, scene fades to white behind). 3–6 per video.
- `Sparkles {t,x,y,r,n=4,size=22,color=goldLight,seed,p,period}` a few twinkling 4-point stars around a hero object ·
  `Halo {id,x,y,r,color=lavender,p,strength}` soft radial glow behind it (gems = lavender, treasure/discovery = gold).
- `Steam {t,x,y,w,h,n,color,strength}` rising wisps · `Flame {t,x,y,s,seed,glow}` candle/torch · `Ripples {t,x,y,r,n,period,color,sy}`

## People (`kit/people`) — origin = feet, ≈540 px tall at s=1, drawn facing right (`facing=-1` mirrors)
- `Person {x,y,s,facing,t, pose?, arms?:{front:[shoulderDeg,elbowDeg],back:[…]}, walk?:phase(cycles), stride, sit:0..1, lie:0..1, lean, look:-1..1, tilt,
  expression:'neutral'|'smile'|'happy'|'worried'|'surprised'|'thinking'|'sad'|'angry'|'determined', talk:0..1, blink?, skin:0..4,
  hair:'short'|'long'|'bun'|'curly'|'bald'|'tonsure'|'side'|'ponytail'|'none', hairColor, beard:'none'|'short'|'full'|'moustache', glasses,
  outfit:'tunic'|'robe'|'dress'|'coat'|'labcoat'|'suit'|'casual'|'royal'|'scrubs'|'nightwear'|'peasant'|'merchant'|'nun'|'soldier'|'worker', top,bottom,accent,
  hat:'none'|'coif'|'hood'|'tophat'|'crown'|'cap'|'brimmed'|'scholar'|'veil'|'beret'|'surgical'|'helmet'|'hardhat'|'wimple', hatColor, shoes,
  age:'child'|'adult'|'elder', build:'slim'|'average'|'heavy', prop?:'book'|'scroll'|'cup'|'basket'|'tool'|'lantern'|'phone', propColor, silhouette?:colour, opacity, seed}`
  poses: idle point wave(animated) think shrug present hold write cheer worried armsOut reach handsBack facepalm cross|armsCrossed carry kneel handsOnHips awe.
  nun/soldier/worker default to hat wimple/helmet/hardhat. child = 0.62× size, bigger head; elder = grey hair + stoop. prop sits in the front hand.
  Lying: `lie={1}` → body flat along the floor ≈62·s above y, head toward the back (facing -1 puts the head on the right).
  Walk: `walk={t*0.9}` + move x yourself (≈ 150 px/s at s=1). Talk: `talk={Math.abs(Math.sin(t*9))}` while speaking.
  Sitting: `sit={1}` → hips at height ≈118·s above the feet, ≈104·s behind them (place the seat there).
  Emote: `emote:'idea'|'question'|'exclaim'|'sweat'|'anger'|'love'|'sleep'|'storm'|'sparkle'`, `emoteP:0..1` pop-in (default 1) → animated icon by the head (follows facing/scale/sit/lie, idle life from t).
- `Emote {x,y,kind,s=1,t,p=1,color?}` standalone emotion icon, origin = centre, ≈100 px at s=1.
- `personHands(props)` → {front,back,head} world positions (attach held objects).
- `Crowd {x,y,w,n=9,rows=2,t,seed,s=0.6,era:'medieval'|'19thc'|'modern',silhouette?,facing:1|-1|'mixed',expression, variety?:bool (mix children/elders + builds)}`

# archival — `src/kit/archival.tsx` (real-image templates)

**Real images edited like a top YouTube storyteller: brisk, always moving, always meaning something, credit every image.**

Same contract as `templates`: each is a full-frame `<Stage>`, a pure function of absolute `t` for a shot `a → b`,
entrances keyed to cue props (`at`, `…At`, per-item `at`), alive holds, works inside `<Shots>`.
Shared props (`ArchBase`): `t a b slug tone? seed? credit? tint?: 'paper'|'sepia'|'ink'|'none' (default paper) caption?`.
Image coords: `rx, ry` = 0..1 of the SOURCE image. `Focus = [fx, fy, zoom]` aims the camera on the image
(zoom 1 = just covers the frame). Always pass `aspect` = source width / height (overlays depend on it).
`credit` is always drawn small (ink pill bottom-right on images); `caption` → storytelling lower third (+ `kicker`).
Gallery: `{"page":"archival"}` (stills 3.5, 7.5 … 27.5) and `{"page":"archival2"}` (3.5 ImageInWorld, 7.5 ParallaxCutout).
Helpers exported: `ArchImage` (one image in a window, origin top-left, cover-fit, focus/tint/dim/wash/clip),
`viewRect` + `onView` (map image coords → window px), `LowerThird`, `CreditLine`.
Full-frame templates show square/portrait images (`aspect` < 1.3) WHOLE at full height (zoom 1 = fit height, centred) over a darkened,
blurred copy of the same image; landscape images cover the frame as before. `viewRect` follows the same rule for 1920×1080 windows.

## KenBurnsShot
Slow motivated move from→to (eased, log zoom) + `beats` re-aiming the camera on cue (eased 1.1 s punch-in, or `cut:true` = hard punch).
```ts
<KenBurnsShot {...base} slug src aspect? from?: Focus to?: Focus beats?: {at, focus: Focus, cut?}[]
  frame?: 'full'|'print' vignette?=true caption? kicker? captionAt? credit? at? />   // print: framed print on tone backdrop
```
```tsx
<KenBurnsShot t={t} a={T.k} b={T.l} slug="medieval-baths" src="img/tournai.jpg" aspect={801/482} caption="Burial of plague victims, Tournai, 1349"
  credit="Pierart dou Tielt · Public domain" beats={[{at: T.coffins, focus: [0.3, 0.56, 1.75]}]}/>
```

## DetailHuntShot
Starts wide, punches into each detail on cue and annotates it (draw-on ellipse/box + leader + label plate, semantic colour),
returns wide at `returnAt` with all details as numbered markers. Zoom is automatic (detail ≈ 45 % of frame), label goes to the open side.
```ts
type Detail = {rx, ry (centre), rw, rh, label, note?, at?, kind?: Sem, shape?: 'ellipse'|'box', zoom?}
<DetailHuntShot {...base} slug src aspect? details: Detail[] returnAt?: number|false (default b−1.4) kicker? caption? credit? at? />
```
```tsx
<DetailHuntShot t={t} a={T.d} b={T.e} slug="medieval-baths" src="img/harvest.jpg" aspect={2613/2905}
  details={[{rx:0.67, ry:0.28, rw:0.4, rh:0.2, label:'Cabbages on his head', at:T.basket}, {rx:0.41, ry:0.67, rw:0.14, rh:0.14, label:'Her basket', shape:'box', at:T.pick}]}/>
```
Allow ≥ 1.6 s per detail (punch 1 s, mark +0.6, label +0.9).

## MontageShot
2–8 images cut on cues, each with its own small move (seeded push / pull / pan, or `from`/`to`); one tint unifies mixed sources.
```ts
type MontageItem = {src, aspect?, credit?, caption?, kicker?, from?: Focus, to?: Focus}
<MontageShot {...base} slug items cuts?: number[] (n starts, or n−1 = starts of items 2…n) transition?: 'cut'|'dissolve'|'slide'
  tint? counter?=true kicker? at? />   // cut = hard cut + 4 % punch; slide = incoming slides over with an oxblood edge
```
```tsx
<MontageShot t={t} a={T.m} b={T.n} slug="medieval-baths" transition="cut" cuts={[T.m, T.b1, T.b2, T.b3]}
  items={[{src:'img/tournai.jpg', aspect:801/482, credit:'…'}, {src:'img/harvest.jpg', aspect:2613/2905, credit:'…', caption:'Cabbage harvest, c. 1390'}]}/>
```

## CollageShot
2–6 prints on a board (paper pinboard or `dark`), slight rotations, tape or pins, flat shadows; they drop in on cues, the camera drifts.
`link` = red string (pin to pin) or arrow between two items + optional Tag label. Labels/credits are written on each print's margin (long credits wrap; the paper widens to fit).
Auto-placed prints are re-centred on the frame; the link label is moved clear of the prints.
```ts
type CollageItem = {src, aspect?, credit?, label?, at?, x?, y?, w?, rot?, fasten?: 'tape'|'pin'}
<CollageShot {...base} slug items board?: 'paper'|'dark' tint? link?: {from, to, at?, style?: 'string'|'arrow', label?, kind?: Sem} at? gap?=0.45 />
```
```tsx
<CollageShot t={t} a={T.c} b={T.d} slug="medieval-baths" items={[{src:'img/tournai.jpg', aspect:801/482, label:'Tournai, 1349', credit:'…'}, …]}
  link={{from:0, to:1, at:T.link, label:'Same century'}}/>
```

## CompareImagesShot
Two images: `side` (two framed panels, labels, semantic tags, "vs" seal, optional title) or `wipe` (full-frame slider wipes the right
image in and settles at `split`, breathing). Then vs now, claim vs evidence.
```ts
type CompareSideImg = {src, aspect?, label, sub?, tag?: {text, kind?: Sem}, credit?, from?: Focus, to?: Focus}
<CompareImagesShot {...base} slug left right mode?='side' split?=0.5 tint? title? (side) at? rightAt? />   // default tone shade
```
```tsx
<CompareImagesShot t={t} a={T.c} b={T.d} slug="medieval-baths" mode="wipe" rightAt={T.now}
  left={{src:'img/then.jpg', aspect:1.5, label:'Then', sub:'1349', credit:'…'}} right={{src:'img/now.jpg', aspect:1.5, label:'Now', tag:{text:'Photograph', kind:'evidence'}}}/>
```

## DocumentScanShot
Document/manuscript page: a lamp scan bar sweeps (reveals) it, then each region gets a marker highlight + outline on cue and a
transcription/translation card in the right column (leader line); `lens` = magnifier inset showing the active region.
```ts
type DocRegion = {rx, ry (TOP-LEFT), rw, rh, at?, kind?: Sem (default caution), label?, text?}
<DocumentScanShot {...base} slug src aspect? (w/h, default 0.75) regions lens?=true scan?=true kicker? title? credit? at? gap?=1.1 />
```
```tsx
<DocumentScanShot t={t} a={T.d} b={T.e} slug="medieval-baths" src="img/decree.jpg" aspect={0.745} title="The decree" kicker="Paris · 1348"
  regions={[{rx:0.43, ry:0.25, rw:0.15, rh:0.1, label:'Opening words', text:'When the Author of the universe…', at:T.open}]}/>
```
Keep ≤ 3 regions with text, text ≤ ~70 chars.

## AnnotatedImageShot
"Animation on top of reality" (the Binly signature): full-frame image + flat-vector overlays drawn on cue, tracking the slow move.
Strokes carry a paper halo so they read on any image; `dim` = ink veil so marks pop.
```ts
type Overlay =
  | {kind:'arrow', from:[rx,ry], to:[rx,ry], at?, sem?, bend?, label?}
  | {kind:'outline', rx, ry (centre), rw, rh, at?, sem?, shape?: 'ellipse'|'box', dashed? (= inferred, plum), label?}
  | {kind:'label', rx, ry, text, note?, at?, sem?, dx?, dy?}
  | {kind:'icon', rx, ry, icon: IconName, at?, sem?, label?}
  | {kind:'flow', points: [rx,ry][], at?, sem?, label?, dur?}      // spline + travelling dots
<AnnotatedImageShot {...base} slug src aspect? overlays from? to? dim?=0.12 kicker? caption? credit? at? gap?=0.5 />
```
```tsx
<AnnotatedImageShot t={t} a={T.a} b={T.b} slug="medieval-baths" src="img/harvest.jpg" aspect={2613/2905} overlays={[
  {kind:'outline', rx:0.75, ry:0.62, rw:0.42, rh:0.34, shape:'box', label:'Shared hot tub', at:T.tub},
  {kind:'flow', points:[[0.43,0.42],[0.47,0.52],[0.55,0.6]], label:'Way in', sem:'evidence', at:T.walk}]}/>
```

## ImageInWorldShot
The image as an object in a scene, then the camera pushes into it until it fills the frame ("zoom into the evidence"), keeps a
slow Ken Burns and shows caption + credit. setting `desk` (top-down desk under a lamp), `museum` (framed on a gallery wall,
visitors), `hands` (a Person holds the print up; `person` overrides PersonProps).
```ts
<ImageInWorldShot {...base} slug src aspect? setting?='desk' pushAt?: number|false (default a+1.4) pushDur?=1.6
  label? (top-left plate before the push) person? caption? kicker? credit? at? />
```
```tsx
<ImageInWorldShot t={t} a={T.w} b={T.x} slug="medieval-baths" src="img/tournai.jpg" aspect={801/482} setting="museum" pushAt={T.look}
  label="Room 14 · Medieval Flanders" caption="Burial of plague victims, Tournai, 1349" credit="Pierart dou Tielt · Public domain"/>
```

## ParallaxCutoutShot
Fake 2.5D without segmentation: the image recedes (`ink` darken or `paper` wash + desaturate, never blur) while a crop of it lifts
off at `at` as a paper cut-out with a flat shadow and travels at a different parallax speed during the pan.
```ts
type Cut = {rx, ry (TOP-LEFT), rw, rh, shape?: 'rect'|'ellipse'} | {points: [rx,ry][]}
<ParallaxCutoutShot {...base} slug src aspect? cut from?: Focus to?: Focus depth?=1 recede?='ink'
  label?: {text, kind?, at?} kicker? caption? credit? at? (default a+0.5) />
```
```tsx
<ParallaxCutoutShot t={t} a={T.p} b={T.q} slug="medieval-baths" src="img/harvest.jpg" aspect={2613/2905} from={[0.4,0.3,1.15]} to={[0.52,0.34,1.22]}
  cut={{rx:0.355, ry:0.15, rw:0.15, rh:0.28, shape:'ellipse'}} label={{text:'The visitors'}} at={T.lift}/>
```

# data — `src/kit/data.tsx`

Data visualisation for **exact** statistics: every number shown comes from an explicit prop, so the screen
says exactly what the narration says. Numbers in Fraunces 700, labels in Inter caps. All take `p` 0→1
(build-on; settled at 1). Count-ups land exactly on the given string (uses `countUp`). Gallery: `{"page":"data"}`.

Helpers: `fmtNum(12500) → "12,500"`, `fmtYear(-400) → "400 BCE"` (`fmtYear(y, true)` adds " CE").

## BarChart
Vertical bars growing staggered; value labels count up on top, category labels below.
Box (x,y)=top-left, w×h **includes** value + category labels. `highlight` index → oxblood, others muted.
```ts
<BarChart x y w h bars: {label; value; color?; valueLabel?}[]; p; max?; highlight?; color?=C.inkLift;
  highlightColor?=C.oxblood; grid?=true; labelSize?=36 />
```
```tsx
<BarChart x={200} y={200} w={800} h={500} p={ramp(t,1,3)} highlight={0}
  bars={[{label:'Florence', value:60, valueLabel:'60%'}, {label:'Paris', value:50, valueLabel:'50%'}]} />
```
Labels may use `"\n"` for two lines. Keep slot width (w / bars) ≥ label width.

## DotGrid
Waffle / "26 out of 100". Origin = top-left. Empty dots fade in, then filled dots fill **in order**.
```ts
<DotGrid x y cols rows filled?; p; size?=26; gap?=size*0.42; color?=C.oxblood; empty?=C.paperDeep;
  groups?: {count; color}[]; shape?: 'dot'|'square'|'person'; order?: 'row'|'col' />
dotGridSize(cols, rows, size?, gap?) → {w, h}
```
```tsx
<DotGrid x={700} y={250} cols={10} rows={10} filled={26} size={40} p={ramp(t,0.5,4)} />
<DotGrid x={700} y={250} cols={10} rows={10} groups={[{count:26,color:C.oxblood},{count:40,color:C.theory}]} p={p} />
```

## PercentRing
Donut filling to `value` (0–100) while the exact `label` counts up in the centre. Origin = centre.
```ts
<PercentRing x y r?=120 value label p; color?=C.oxblood; track?=C.paperShade; thick?=r*0.2; caption?; labelSize? />
```
```tsx
<PercentRing x={960} y={500} r={180} value={26} label="26%" caption="of waking moments" p={ramp(t,1,3)} />
```

## Comparison
A-vs-B split panel. Box (x,y)=top-left of both panels. Side = `{title; value?; body?; color?; count?}`
(`count:false` for years/IDs). Left slides in, then right, then the VS badge (`vs={null}` hides it).
```ts
<Comparison x y w h left: Side; right: Side; p; vs?='vs'; gap?=36; valueSize?; bodySize?=30 />
```
```tsx
<Comparison x={140} y={300} w={1640} h={420} p={ramp(t,0,2)}
  left={{title:'Miasma theory', value:'1,500', body:'years as the accepted explanation.', color:C.theory}}
  right={{title:'Germ theory', value:'1861', count:false, body:'Pasteur shows microbes cause decay.', color:C.evidence}} />
```
Keep bodies to ≤ 2 lines per panel (h ≈ 270 fits title + value + 2 body lines at the default sizes).

## TimelineAxis
Year axis that draws on, ticks, staggered event pins (above/below, alternating by default), optional moving
`cursor` (year) shown as an oxblood progress line + year pill (tick labels under the pill hide).
Origin = left end of the axis; needs ~110 px above/below for event labels, ~60 px below for ticks/cursor.
```ts
<TimelineAxis x y w from to p; events?: {year; label; above?; color?; stem?=70; yearLabel?}[];
  ticks?: number[] | step; cursor?: year; format?: (y)=>string; color?=C.ink; cursorColor?=C.oxblood;
  labelSize?=44; tickLabels?=true />
```
```tsx
<TimelineAxis x={160} y={600} w={1600} from={-500} to={2000} ticks={500} p={ramp(t,0,3)}
  cursor={keys(t,[[1,-500],[4,1348]])} events={[{year:1348, label:'Black Death', color:C.oxblood, above:true}]} />
// deep time:  format={(y) => `${-y / 1e6} MYA`}  with from={-252e6} to={-66e6}
```
Default format: negative → "400 BCE"; if the range crosses 0 positives get " CE". Use different `stem`
lengths for neighbouring events on the same side so labels don't collide.

## LineChart
Straight-segment line drawing on left→right with a flat area under it and a leading dot.
Box (x,y,w,h) = **plot area**; y-tick labels sit ~70 px left, x-ticks ~40 px below, `xLabel` ~80 px below,
`yLabel` above the top-left corner. `highlight` point (index or `{index,label}`) pops when the line reaches it.
```ts
<LineChart x y w h points: [x, y][]; p; xLabel?; yLabel?; highlight?: number | {index; label?};
  xDomain?; yDomain?; xTicks?; yTicks?; fmtX?=String; fmtY?=fmtNum; color?=C.oxblood; area?=true />
```
```tsx
<LineChart x={300} y={250} w={1300} h={550} p={ramp(t,0.5,4)} yDomain={[0,100]} yTicks={[0,50,100]}
  points={[[1340,75],[1351,50],[1400,40]]} fmtY={(v)=>`${v}M`} highlight={{index:1, label:'50M'}} yLabel="Europe population" />
```

## Meter
Horizontal certainty bar. Origin = left end of the track centre line. Marker + `valueLabel` above,
end `labels` below, optional `title` higher up. `zones` tints the track in equal bands.
```ts
<Meter x y w value: 0..1; labels: [left, right]; p; color?=C.oxblood; title?; valueLabel?; zones?: string[]; thick?=22 />
```
```tsx
<Meter x={560} y={600} w={800} value={0.35} labels={['Speculation','Confirmed']} valueLabel="Debated" color={C.caution} p={p} />
```

## Gauge
Semicircular dial with needle (gentle overshoot). Origin = needle pivot. `valueLabel` under the pivot.
```ts
<Gauge x y r?=150 value: 0..1; labels: [left, right]; p; color?=C.oxblood; valueLabel?; zones?: string[]; thick?=r*0.17 />
```
```tsx
<Gauge x={960} y={640} r={260} value={0.72} labels={['Guess','Proven']} valueLabel="Likely"
  zones={[C.theoryTint, C.cautionTint, C.evidenceTint]} color={C.evidence} p={ramp(t,0.5,2.5)} />
```

## BalanceScale
"Weighing two theories". Origin = beam pivot; at s=1 beam 460 px wide, stand down to y+330.
`tilt` −1…1 (**animate it yourself**; +1 = right pan down). Items: a number (stack of weight blocks in the
side colour) or any SVG node drawn at the pan rim centre. Labels stay true-size at any `s`.
```ts
<BalanceScale x y tilt; leftLabel?; rightLabel?; leftItems?: number | ReactNode; rightItems?;
  leftColor?=C.theory; rightColor?=C.evidence; color?=C.ink; s?=1; p?=1; labelSize?=36 />
```
```tsx
<BalanceScale x={960} y={380} tilt={keys(t,[[1,0],[2,-0.6],[3.5,0.8]])} leftLabel="Miasma" rightLabel="Germs"
  leftItems={2} rightItems={5} />
```

## CounterRow
Row of exact figures counting up in turn, separated by thin rules, caps labels below.
Origin = left end of the row at the numbers' baseline; total width w.
```ts
<CounterRow x y w items: {value; label; color?; count?}[]; p; size?=88 />
```
```tsx
<CounterRow x={260} y={600} w={1400} p={ramp(t,0,3)}
  items={[{value:'1347', label:'Arrives', count:false}, {value:'25M', label:'Dead', color:C.oxblood}]} />
```

# depth — `src/kit/depth.tsx`

"Looks 3D, drawn flat": orthographic globe, 2:1 isometric blocks, shaded spheres, perspective layer stacks.
Pure SVG — no WebGL, blur or gradients; depth = projection maths + flat crescent shades + parallax. Light from
the upper-left (tops lightest, left faces mid, right faces darkest). Gallery: `{"page":"depth"}`.

## Globe
Orthographic world-atlas globe. Origin = centre, radius `r`. `rotate` = `[lon, lat]` facing the camera —
animate it to spin / turn to a region. Data 110m (r ≤ 400) or 50m (r > 400); paths memoised per
(detail, r, rotate rounded to 0.01°), so held frames are cheap. Pins hide on the far side and fade at the
limb; routes are great-circle arcs drawing on with `p`, clipped to the visible hemisphere.
```ts
<Globe x y r rotate?=[0,20] p?=1 land?=C.paperLight sea?=C.paperShade border?=C.inkFaint coast?=C.inkLift
  borders?=true detail?: '50m'|'110m' graticule?: boolean | stepDeg night?=0 (0..1) shade?=true
  light?=[-0.6,-0.8] rim?=true
  highlight?: {countries: (name | ISO numeric)[]; color?=C.oxLight; p?}[]
  pins?: {lon; lat; label?; color?=C.oxblood; side?: 'right'|'left'; p?}[]
  routes?: {from: [lon,lat]; to: [lon,lat]; p?; color?=C.oxblood; dashed?; width?}[]>{children}</Globe>
```
```tsx
const k = ramp(t, 0, 3.5);
<Globe x={420} y={480} r={300} rotate={[lerp(-80, 14, k), lerp(22, 44, k)]} night={0.3}
  highlight={[{countries: ['France'], p: ramp(t, 3, 3.6)}]} pins={[{lon: 2.35, lat: 48.86, label: 'Paris'}]}
  routes={[{from: [-74, 40.7], to: [2.35, 48.86], p: ramp(t, 1, 3), dashed: true}]} />
```
Cost: ~30 ms JS per new rotation (110m), first frame ~0.1–0.3 s; one globe page renders in ~3 s/frame locally.

## globeProject · globeFacing
Pure helpers (same maths as Globe). `globeProject` → px relative to the centre (+ `at`), `null` on the far side.
`globeFacing` → 1 at the centre, 0 at the limb, < 0 behind (use it to fade your own overlays).
```ts
globeProject(rotate, r, at?: {x?, y?}) → (lon, lat) => [x, y] | null
globeFacing(rotate, lon, lat) → number
```
```tsx
const at = globeProject(rot, 300, {x: 420, y: 480})(2.35, 48.86); // Paris or null
```

## crescentPath · mixTone
`crescentPath(r, angleRad, n)` → path `d` of the disc part beyond a terminator ellipse on side `angle`
(n 0 → nothing, 0.5 → half, 1 → full). The flat shade used by Globe/Sphere — reuse it for any round thing.
`mixTone(a, b, k)` → hex mix of two palette colours (accepts hex or rgb(), chainable).

## iso · isoShades
2:1 isometric projection. World axes: +x → right-down, +y → left-down, +z → up; 1 unit = 1 px at s = 1.
All Iso* components take `x, y` = screen point of their world origin (back ground corner), so place a scene
by adding `iso(gx, gy, gz)` to one origin.
```ts
iso(x, y, z?=0, s?=1) → [sx, sy]
isoShades(base) → {top, left, right}            // light upper-left
```
```tsx
const at = (gx, gy, gz = 0) => { const [a, b] = iso(gx, gy, gz); return [O.x + a, O.y + b]; };
```
Painter's order: draw objects back to front (ascending gx + gy).

## IsoBox · IsoTile · IsoFloor
Box w × d × h rising from the ground with `p`; flat cast shadow to the lower-right. IsoTile = one slab tile.
IsoFloor = slab of cols × rows checker tiles that drop in as a diagonal wave (origin = back corner of its top).
```ts
<IsoBox x y w d h s?=1 color?=C.stone colors?: {top,left,right} p?=1 shadow?=true>{children}</IsoBox>
<IsoTile x y size?=48 h?=8 color?=C.stone s? p? />
<IsoFloor x y cols rows size?=48 colors?=[stone, light stone] grout? thick?=14 gap?=2.5 s? p? />
```

## IsoBuilding
Footprint w × d, `floors` × 44 (medieval) / 36 (modern). roof 'gable' (ridge along the longer side, tile
courses, optional chimney) | 'flat' (parapet + roof unit). Medieval: stone, or timber-framed plaster upper
floors over a stone ground floor (`material`, else seeded); small framed windows, plank door. Modern: concrete,
ribbon windows. `windowsLit` 0..1 = seeded fraction of lit (lamp) windows. p = rises from the ground.
```ts
<IsoBuilding x y w?=120 d?=100 floors?=2 roof?='gable'|'flat' era?='medieval'|'modern' windowsLit?=0
  p?=1 seed?=1 s?=1 wall? roofColor? chimney? door?=true shadow?=true material?: 'timber'|'stone' />
isoChimneyTop({w, d, floors, era, s}) → [dx, dy]   // chimney top, relative to the building origin (Steam)
```
```tsx
const [cx, cy] = isoChimneyTop({w: 200, d: 104, floors: 1});
<IsoBuilding x={bx} y={by} w={200} d={104} floors={1} chimney p={ramp(t,1,2)} />
<Steam t={t} x={bx + cx} y={by + cy} w={40} h={150} n={3} />
```

## IsoStairs
`steps` steps up to height h. dir 'left' = risers face the left-front, climbing toward the back-right (put a
platform IsoBox behind it at the same h); 'right' = risers face the right-front.
```ts
<IsoStairs x y w d h steps?=6 dir?='left'|'right' color?=C.stone s? p? shadow? />
```

## IsoRoom
Stage for small iso props: floor slab with tile grid + two thick back walls (left on x = 0, right on y = 0),
skirting, optional window with a flat light patch. `children` draw inside, in the room's local frame
(origin = back floor corner) — place props with `iso(x, y)`.
```ts
<IsoRoom x y w d h wallColors?: {left?=C.bone, right?=C.boneShade} floorColor?=C.stone tiles?=40 (0 = none)
  window?=true thick?=12 s? p?>{children}</IsoRoom>
```
```tsx
<IsoRoom x={1700} y={300} w={180} d={150} h={140}>
  <IsoCylinder x={iso(96, 84)[0]} y={iso(96, 84)[1]} r={36} h={34} kind="tub" />
</IsoRoom>
```

## IsoCylinder
Origin = screen point of the base centre; `r` = world radius (screen half-width r·1.41·s). Flat vertical
shade bands. kind presets: 'tower' (stone, cone roof, slit windows), 'tub' (wood, open top with liquid
`fill`), 'barrel' (wood, iron hoops, lid), 'plain'. `top` overrides: 'flat' | 'cone' | 'open' | 'crenel'.
```ts
<IsoCylinder x y r h kind?='plain' top? color? roofColor?=C.slate roofH?=r*1.6 fill?=0.7 fillColor?=C.water
  windows? s?=1 p?=1 shadow?=true seed? />
```

## Sphere
Reads round from flat crescents: terminator shade, deeper core shadow, rim (bounce light on the dark edge) and
a flat specular blob. Seeded surface `pattern` spins with `rotate` (deg; `tilt` = axial tilt toward camera).
`preset` sets defaults (explicit props win): planet (bands), moon (craters + maria), cell (spots, highlight),
eyeball (plain, highlight). `children` draw on the surface (clipped, origin = centre) under the shading.
```ts
<Sphere x y r preset?: 'planet'|'moon'|'cell'|'eyeball' color? light?=[-0.6,-0.8] terminator?=0.3 rim?
  highlight? pattern?: 'none'|'bands'|'spots'|'craters' patternColor? seed?=1 rotate?=0 tilt?=14
  outline?=true p?=1>{children}</Sphere>
```
```tsx
<Sphere x={990} y={820} r={118} preset="planet" rotate={t * 25} />
<Sphere x={1730} y={828} r={80} preset="eyeball"><circle cx={10} r={32} fill={C.evidenceLight} /><circle cx={10} r={15} fill={C.ink} /></Sphere>
```

## DepthStack · depthAt
Flat layers at depths `z` (1 = main plane, 2 = twice as far, 0.5 = foreground) viewed through a perspective
camera: scale = zoom·z / (z − cam.z), pan shift ∝ 1 / (z − cam.z). Each layer is drawn in its own frame
(default 1920×1080) and looks exactly as designed at rest (cam at frame centre, z 0, zoom 1). Dolly = animate
`cam.z` toward the layers: near ones grow fast, fade and pass the camera (hidden at z − cam.z < 0.12).
`haze` 0..1 veils layers beyond `focus` with flat `hazeColor` (atmospheric perspective, no blur).
```ts
<DepthStack layers: {el; z}[] cam: {x; y; zoom?=1; z?=0} focus?=1 haze?=0 hazeColor?=C.paper
  frame?={x:0, y:0, w:1920, h:1080} />
depthAt(z, cam, frame?) → {dz, s, dx, dy}
```
```tsx
const k = ramp(t, 0, 4);
<DepthStack cam={{x: 960 + k * 60, y: 540, z: k * 0.7}} haze={0.5} hazeColor={C.sky}
  layers={[{z: 5, el: <Mountains />}, {z: 2.4, el: <Hills />}, {z: 1, el: <Town />}, {z: 0.8, el: <Arch />}]} />
```
vs stage.tsx `World`/`Cam`: those are orthographic parallax (layer offset ∝ depth factor, zoom blended
linearly) — best for pans and gentle push-ins with keyframed `CamKeys`. Use DepthStack when the camera should
travel *into* the scene (layers pass the lens, far layers barely move). Both can nest: put a DepthStack inside
a `Cam` for an extra shake/rotation.

# kit/env — environments & props

`import {…} from '../kit/env'`. Flat stepped colour, upper-left light, palette only. Everything is a pure
function of props; `t` = idle life (cloud drift, sway, flicker, ripples), `seed` = variation.

**Conventions**
- Environments fill 1920×1080 at s=1, origin = frame top-left, with ~400px overscan left/right/below for parallax.
- Interiors share the floor line `ENV_FLOOR` = **820** (character feet). Streets: medieval cobbles/modern sidewalk start at 820.
- Props: origin = **base / bottom-centre** unless noted. All props accept `x, y, s, flip`.
- Types: `Tone = 'day'|'dusk'|'night'|'overcast'`, `Layer = 'far'|'mid'|'near'`, `Era = 'medieval'|'early-modern'|'modern'`, `RoomEra = 'medieval'|'19thc'|'modern'`.
- Helpers: `mixC(a, b, k)` (chainable colour mix, accepts hex or rgb()), `toned(color, tone, far01)` (re-tint a material for time of day + atmosphere), `skyBands(tone)` (5 sky colours top→horizon), `BOOK_COLORS`.

## Parallax recipe
```tsx
<World cam={cam} layers={[
  {depth: 0.1, el: <Sky variant="dusk" t={t}/>},
  {depth: 0.3, el: <Hills layer="far" tone="dusk"/>},
  {depth: 0.5, el: <CitySkyline era="medieval" layer="mid" tone="dusk" walls/>},
  {depth: 1,   el: <Ground y={860} tone="dusk"/>},
  {depth: 1.3, el: <Trees layer="near" tone="dusk" t={t} x0={-200} x1={400}/>},
]}/>
```

## Sky & landscape (origin = frame)
- **Sky** — stepped 5-band sky, sun (day/dusk) or moon (night), stars, drifting clouds.
  `{variant?: Tone='day'; t?; horizon?=760; stars?: bool (default night); sun?=true; sunX?; sunY?; moon?: 'full'|'crescent'; clouds?: n; cloudSpeed?=1; seed?}`
  `<Sky variant="night" t={t} moon="crescent"/>`
- **Cloud** — single flat cloud, origin bottom-centre. `{w?=300; color?; shade?; o?}`
- **Moon** — disc with halo, origin centre. `{x; y; r?=60; phase?: 'full'|'crescent'}`
- **Stars** — twinkling field in a box. `{t?; seed?; x?; y?; w?; h?; n?=80}`
- **Hills** — rolling band, shade on right-facing slopes, fills to bottom. `y` = crest base.
  `{layer?: Layer='mid'; seed?; tone?; color?; y? (650/730/850); amp?; shade?=true; shape?: 'round'|'peak' (jagged ridges); caps?: colour (snow caps on peaks)}`
- **Ground** — flat plane from `y` down with sparse marks. `{y?=820; kind?: 'grass'|'earth'|'sand'|'snow'; tone?; color?; seed?}`
- **Tree** — single tree, origin trunk base. `{kind?: 'round'|'conifer'|'bare'|'poplar'|'palm'|'cactus'|'snowy'; h?=300; t?; seed?; tone?; far?: 0..1; color?; trunk?}`
- **Trees** — seeded row. `{layer?; kind?: TreeKind|'mixed'; y?; x0?=-250; x1?=2170; density?=1; h?=300; t?; tone?; seed?}`
- **Water** — lake band with drifting ripple dashes + optional sun/moon glint column.
  `{y?=780; h?=400; t?; tone?; glintX?; x?; w?; color?; seed?}`
- **Landscape** — ready composite (sky, hills, trees, optional lake, ground). `{tone?; seed?; t?; water?: bool; trees?: TreeKind|'mixed'; biome?: 'temperate'|'desert'|'mountains'|'coast'|'jungle'|'snow'}`
  Biomes are NOT a default backdrop — use one only when the narration is set in that place (a desert crossing, a
  mountain pass, a coastline, a jungle, winter); otherwise the scene's place comes from the story (city, room, map…). biomes (all tones): desert = dunes, mesas, cacti · mountains = snow-capped peaks, conifers · coast = sea + surf, beach from y 930, palms · jungle = dense canopy + palms · snow = white hills, snowy conifers. `water`/`trees` = temperate only.
  `<Landscape tone="dusk" water t={t}/>` (lake shore / floor ≈ y 955; without water, near hill ≈ 870–900)

## City
- **CitySkyline** — silhouette band; `y` = building ground line (buildings extend below). Night ⇒ lit windows (some flicker with `t`).
  `{era?: Era='medieval'; layer?: Layer='mid'; tone?; y?; lit?; t?; walls?: bool (medieval town wall + gate towers); color?; seed?; x0?; x1?}`
  medieval: gabled houses, towers, church spire · early-modern: stepped/bell gables, domes, clock tower · modern: blocks, rooftop kit, window grids.
- **Street** — full street scene: sky, far + mid skyline, row of facades, street surface (floor 820).
  `{era?: 'medieval'|'modern'; tone?: Tone='day'; t?; seed?}` · medieval = stone ground floor, jettied half-timber, cobbles, lanterns at night; modern = shopfronts + awnings, sidewalk 820–880, road, lamp posts.
  `<Street era="medieval" tone="night" t={t}/>`
- **StreetLamp** — modern lamp post, origin pole base. `{h?=420; lit?; color?}`

## Interiors (origin = frame, floor at 820)
- **Room** — `{era?: RoomEra='19thc'; wall?; floor?; trim?; window?: 'arched'|'square'|'none'; windowX?; door?=true; doorX?; doorOpen?: 0..1; light?=true (LightShaft + floor patch); night?; sky?: Tone; t?; seed?}`
  medieval = stone blocks, ceiling beam + corbels, arched window, plank door, flagstones · 19thc = striped wallpaper, picture rail, wainscot, sash window with curtains, panel door · modern = plain wall, radiator, pendant lamp, flush door.
  `<Room era="medieval" windowX={400} doorX={1600} t={t}/>`
- **Floor** — floor band. `{y?=820; color?; kind?: 'planks'|'flags'|'tiles'; seed?}`
- **Bathhouse** — medieval public bath: stone arcade, oculi + light shafts, beams, two wooden tubs (left under linen canopy at x 460, right x 1470, base y≈900), bench, buckets, steam.
  `{t?; seed?; layer?: 'all'|'back'|'front'}` — draw `layer="back"`, then bathers, then `layer="front"` (tub fronts + steam).
- **Lab** — counter (top y 640) with microscope, glassware, test tubes; wall shelves; window; modern adds monitor + strip light, 19thc a retort + burner + lantern.
  `{t?; era?: '19thc'|'modern'; night?; seed?}`
- **Classroom** — chalkboard (x 560–1380, y 180–580) with faint notes, clock, window, teacher desk, foreground desks.
  `{t?; time?: hours; layer?: 'all'|'back'|'front'; seed?}` · **ClassroomFront** `{y?=960; color?}` = the desk row alone.
- **MuseumHall** — arched windows between pilasters, cornice, light shafts, tiled floor, central Plinth (top ≈ y 770).
  `{t?; windows?=4; plinth?=true; wall?; seed?}`
- **Study** — dark panelled library: tall bookshelves both sides, framed map, desk across the front (top y 690) with oil lamp, books, quill.
  `{t?; layer?: 'all'|'back'|'front'; lamp?=true; seed?}` — characters go between `back` and `front`.
- **Bedroom** — night bedroom: curtained window with moon & stars (x 560), moonlight shaft onto the bed (x≈1250), nightstand + candle.
  `{t?; night?=true; candle?: bool (lit); seed?}`
- **MindSpace** — calm ink/plum field with floating soft shapes, slow orbit rings, dust; centre kept clear for text.
  `{t?; bg?: 'ink'|'plum'='plum'; density?=1; seed?}`

## Props (origin = base-centre unless noted; all take x, y, s, flip)
| Prop | Props | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Table | `w?=360 h?=150 color?` | |
| Desk | `w?=440 h?=170 color?` | drawer pedestal right |
| Chair | `h?=240 color?` | side view, faces right (`flip` for left) |
| Bed | `w?=560 frame? blanket? pillow? sheet?` | side view, headboard left |
| Bookshelf | `w?=300 h?=520 seed? shelves? fill?=0.9 color?` | seeded books, leaners, jars |
| BookStack | `n?=4 w?=150 seed?` | |
| OilLamp | `t? lit?=true glow?=1 color?` | ~165 tall, LightPool glow |
| Candle | `t? lit? h?=90 glow? color? holder?` | |
| Torch | `t? lit? glow? seed?` | wall torch, origin = handle bottom |
| Lantern | `t? lit? chain?=0 glow? color?` | `chain` draws chain above the ring |
| Window | `w?=240 h?=360 shape?: 'arched'\|'square' sky?: Tone t? frame? reveal? curtains? curtainColor? moon? panes? seed?` | origin = sill centre |
| Door | `w?=200 h?=360 shape? style?: 'plank'\|'panel'\|'flush' color? frame? open?: 0..1 inside?` | origin = threshold |
| Bathtub | `kind?: 'wood'\|'modern' w?=380 t? water? color? linen? part?: 'all'\|'back'\|'front'` | `back` before a bather, `front` after |
| Bucket | `w?=90 color? water?=true` | |
| Plant | `kind?: 'leafy'\|'tall'\|'bush' seed? t? pot? color?` | sways with t |
| Barrel | `w?=150 h?=200 color?` | |
| Cauldron | `w?=220 t? steam?=true fire? liquid? color?` | bubbles + Steam |
| Scroll | `w?=360 h?=300 p?: 0..1 lines? seed? color?` | origin = **top roll**; `p` unrolls down |
| Bench | `w?=420 h?=110 color?` | |
| Clock | `time?: hours (3.5 = 3:30) r?=90 t? pendulum? color? face?` | origin = **face centre** |
| Bell | `r?=80 t? swing?: deg color?` | origin = **hanging point** |
| Banner | `kind?: 'hanging'\|'flag' w?=200 h?=320 t? color? emblem?: 'none'\|'circle'\|'cross'\|'stripe' trim?` | hanging: origin = **rod centre**; flag: pole foot |
| Plinth | `w?=600 h?=90 color? label?=true` | blank label plate for a Kicker |
| Frame | `w?=300 h?=220 kind?: 'landscape'\|'portrait'\|'map'\|'blank' color?` | origin = **centre** |
| StreetLamp | `h?=420 lit? color?` | |
| Tree | see above | origin = trunk base |
| MarketStall | `w?=360 awning?=C.oxblood goods?: 'fruit'\|'cloth'\|'pots' color?` | striped scalloped awning, ~335 tall |
| Campfire | `t? seed? lit?=true smoke?=true glow?=1` | stone ring, logs, 3 Flames, embers |
| Well | `color?=stone roof?` | stone shaft, gable roof, crank + bucket, ~400 tall |
| Barrels / Crates | `n?=3 w?=120 color?` (+`seed?` crates) | pyramid stack |
| Throne | `color?=brass cushion?=oxblood` | front view, ~475 tall |

**Weather** (in `kit/fx`) — overlay over any scene, deterministic: `<Weather t={t} kind="rain"/>`
`{t; kind: 'rain'|'snow'|'fog'|'wind'|'leaves'; strength?=1; seed?; x?=0 y?=0 w?=1920 h?=1080 (box, clipped); color?}` · fog = drifting flat bands, wind = curling streaks, leaves = tumbling leaves. Snow/fog/wind default to paperLight (use on darker/tinted scenes or pass `color`).
Vehicles (Ship, Cart, Train, Car, Horse) → `docs/kit/transport.md`.

```tsx
<Room era="19thc" t={t}/>
<Desk x={1200} y={ENV_FLOOR}/><OilLamp x={1080} y={ENV_FLOOR - 170} t={t}/>
<Clock x={1500} y={260} r={60} time={10 + t / 60}/>
```

# geo — `src/kit/geo.tsx`

Maps for history/geography beats in an old-print style: paper land, slightly darker sea with an engraved
line along the coast, thin ink coastlines, faint borders + graticule, Fraunces italic sea names.
Data = local world-atlas TopoJSON (`50m` regional, `110m` world) via d3-geo; projections and paths are
memoised per region+size (first frame computes, later frames are cheap). Gallery: `{"page":"geo"}`.

Regions (`REGIONS`): `world` (equalEarth) · `europe`, `western-europe`, `mediterranean`, `north-america`,
`asia` (conicConformal) · `south-america`, `africa`, `middle-east`, `iberia`, `british-isles`, `france`,
`italy`, `low-countries`, `alps` (mercator) — or any bbox `[[W,S],[E,N]]` (mercator). The bbox is fitted
*inside* the box (extra area shows around it).

## makeProjection
Pure helper: the exact projection GeoMap uses. Pass the map's x/y to get absolute stage px.
```ts
makeProjection(region, w, h, {x?, y?, projection?}) → (lon, lat) => [x, y]     // type Proj
```
```tsx
const eu = makeProjection('europe', 1040, 860, {x: 80, y: 100});
const [px, py] = eu(2.35, 48.86); // Paris
```

## GeoMap
Map in the box (x, y, w, h), clipped, with a double neatline frame. `children` draw on top, clipped to the
box (use absolute coords from makeProjection). World maps draw the globe outline instead of a box.
```ts
<GeoMap x y w h region?='europe' projection?: 'mercator'|'equalEarth'|'conicConformal' detail?: '50m'|'110m'
  p?=1 land?=C.paperLight sea?=C.paperShade border?=C.inkFaint coast?=C.inkLift borders?=true
  graticule?: boolean | stepDeg ripples?=(not world) frame?=true
  highlight?: {countries: (name | ISO numeric)[]; color?=C.oxLight; p?; outline?}[]
  labels?: {text; lon; lat; kind?: 'sea'|'region'|'country'; size?; rotate?}[] labelP?=1>{children}</GeoMap>
```
Country names are Natural Earth names (case-insensitive): 'France', 'Spain', 'United States of America',
'Dem. Rep. Congo'… or ISO numeric (`250`, `'076'`). Modern borders — for medieval maps pass `borders={false}`.
```tsx
<GeoMap x={80} y={100} w={1040} h={860} region="europe" p={ramp(t,0,1)}
  labels={[{text:'Mediterranean Sea', lon:6.6, lat:37.8}]} highlight={[{countries:['Italy'], p: ramp(t,1,2)}]}>
  <MapPin {...} />
</GeoMap>
```
Cost: a 50m regional map ≈1–2 s/frame locally (slow PC); avoid more than two maps on screen at once.

## MapPin
Teardrop pin that drops with a gentle settle. Origin = pin tip (the location). Label in Fraunces 32 with a
paper halo, optional `sub` (sans caps 22). `side`: 'right' | 'left' | 'top'.
```ts
<MapPin x y p?=1 label? sub? color?=C.oxblood s?=1 side?='right' />
```

## CityDot
Ring + centre dot city marker with Fraunces label (halo). `side`: 'right' | 'left' | 'top' | 'bottom'.
```ts
<CityDot x y label? p?=1 color?=C.ink side?='right' size?=28 italic?=false />
```

## Route
Line that draws on with a travelling arrowhead. `points` are `[lon,lat]` with `proj`, or px without it.
Two points → arc (`bend` fraction of length, sign flips side). More points → smooth curve through them.
```ts
<Route points proj? p?=1 color?=C.oxblood width?=5 dashed?=false arrow?=true bend?=0.18 dots?=false />
```
```tsx
<Route points={[[28.97,41.0],[15.55,38.19],[5.37,43.3]]} proj={md} p={ramp(t,1,3)} dashed />
```

## SpreadRings
Outbreak / spread marker: filled core + rings expanding on a loop driven by `t`. Origin = centre.
```ts
<SpreadRings t x y r?=110 n?=3 period?=2.4 color?=C.oxblood p?=1 core?=12 />
```

## AreaMark
Region without a modern border (e.g. Brabant, "the Low Countries"): flat tint + dashed rim drawing on,
optional sans-caps label. Origin = centre.
```ts
<AreaMark x y rx ry?=rx*0.7 rot?=0 p?=1 color?=C.theory label? labelDy? />
```

## MapLabel
Map typography. 'sea' = Fraunces italic tracked (no halo), 'region' = sans caps tracked, 'country' = Fraunces caps.
```ts
<MapLabel x y text kind?='sea' size? rotate?=0 p?=1 color? />
```

# icons — `src/kit/icons.tsx`

Bold flat pictogram family (filled geometric shapes + 6px round-capped strokes), two-tone: main `color`
plus one `accent` detail. Gallery: `{"page":"icons"}`.

## Icon
One pictogram. Origin = centre; 96×96 px at `s=1` (content within ±44 px). `p` 0→1 pops it in
(scale + slight turn, gentle settle); `p` defaults to 1 (static).

```ts
<Icon name: IconName; x; y; s?=1; color?=C.ink; accent?=C.oxblood; knock?=C.paper; p?=1; r?=0 />
```
- `knock` paints cut-outs (holes, highlights, separators). **Set it to the background colour** when the
  icon is not on plain paper (e.g. `knock={C.ink}` on a dark panel, with `color={C.paperLight}`).
- Semantic use: `color={C.evidence}` on `check`, `color={C.caution}` on `warning`, etc.

```tsx
<Icon name="lungs" x={960} y={540} s={2} p={ramp(t, 1, 1.6)} />
<Icon name="check" x={300} y={200} color={C.evidence} />
<Icon name="moon" x={1600} y={160} color={C.paperLight} accent={C.lamp} knock={C.night} />
```

## ICON_NAMES
`IconName[]` — every available name (64):

question, exclamation, check, cross, warning, info, eye, brain, ear, mouth, hand, heart, lungs, drop, flame,
thermometer, sun, moon, star, cloud, wind, lightning, clock, hourglass, calendar, book, scroll, document,
quill, magnifier, microscope, flask, pill, syringe, germ, virus, dna, atom, person, people, crown, skull,
house, building, church, castle, globe, pin, key, lock, phone, computer, chip, speech, thought, lightbulb,
coin, scale, shield, chart, gear, arrow-right, arrow-up, bath.

Notes: `check/cross/question/exclamation/info` are badge discs (glyph knocked out); `heart`, `flame`,
`lightning`, `pin` are drawn mainly in `accent`. For other arrow directions use `r` (e.g. `arrow-right` with `r={90}`).

---

## Real archival images (`kit/photo` + `tools/photo.mjs`) — free licences only
Find & fetch (director usually does this during planning; builders may too):
- `node tools/photo.mjs search "Tournai plague 1349" [--n 12]` → `.cache/photos/search.png` (numbered tiles) + list with licence/author/size.
  Unfree (NC/ND/fair-use/copyrighted) and small images are filtered out automatically. Try English, Latin or
  original-language names, artist, museum, manuscript names.
- `node tools/photo.mjs get <#> --as tournai` → `public/<slug>/img/tournai.jpg`, credit appended to `videos/<slug>/CREDITS.md`.
- `Photo {slug, src:'img/x.jpg', x,y,w,h, p, t, rot, frame:'museum'|'print'|'polaroid'|'none', tint:'paper'|'sepia'|'ink'|'none',
  pan?:{a,b,from:[fx,fy,zoom],to:[fx,fy,zoom]}, credit?, caption?, dark?}` origin = centre of the image window.
  `<Photo slug="medieval-baths" src="img/tournai.jpg" x={960} y={480} w={900} h={540} frame="museum" tint="paper" t={t}
   pan={{a:T.s, b:T.s+7, from:[0.5,0.5,1], to:[0.3,0.55,1.35]}} caption="Burial of plague victims, Tournai, 1349" credit="Pierart dou Tielt · Public domain" p={ramp(t,T.s,T.s+0.8)}/>`
- `PhotoMark {x,y,w,h (same as the Photo), rx,ry,rw,rh (0..1 region), p, color, shape:'ellipse'|'box'}` draws attention to a detail.
Rules: each video uses images from its OWN folder `public/<slug>/img/` (tools/photo.mjs saves there for the active video;
the cloud downloads only the rendered video's folder) — to reuse an image from an older video, copy it into this video's folder.
Always show the `credit` line when the licence is CC BY/BY-SA (public domain: credit is courteous, keep it small).
Prefer sources ≥ 1600 px for anything large; small sources only in small frames. Use `tint="paper"` by default so images
sit in the Binly palette. Images are evidence moments inside the animated world — not a slideshow.

# science — `src/kit/science.tsx`

Body, brain and science visuals in flat editorial style (light from upper-left, flat shade crescents on the
lower-right). Colour meaning: flesh/blood = oxblood family (`oxTint`/`oxLight`), signals/thought = theory
plum, healthy/immune = evidence green, germs/warning = caution mustard. All are SVG for a `<Stage>`; most
take `x y s` (+ `o` opacity). Idle life via `t` (seconds). Gallery: `{"page":"science"}`.

Helpers (exported): `smoothPath(pts, closed?)` (Catmull-Rom path through `[x,y][]`),
`makeCurve(pts)` → `{d, len, at(k)→{x,y,a}, sub(k0,k1)}` (arc-length sampling for things moving along a path),
`heartPulse(t, bpm?)` → 0…1.6 lub-dub value, `BRAIN_REGIONS`.

## Brain
Side view, origin = centre of cerebrum, ≈330×330 at s=1 (brainstem reaches y≈+200).
Regions: `frontal | motor | parietal | temporal | occipital | cerebellum | brainstem`.
```ts
<Brain x y s? facing?:'right'|'left' highlight?: Region | Region[] | {[region]: colour} highlightColor?=C.theoryLight
  hp?=1 lobes?=false signal?: 0→1 labels?: true | Region[] labelP?=1 fill?=C.oxTint o? />
```
`lobes` colour-codes every lobe (map look). `signal` = plum pulse frontal → motor cortex → brainstem (motor
command). Labels sit outside the brain (≈ ±230·s px wide incl. text), always upright.
```tsx
<Brain x={960} y={500} s={1.4} highlight="motor" hp={ramp(t,1,2)} signal={ramp(t,2,3.5,ease.linear)} labels={['motor']} />
```

## HeadProfile
Bald editorial head in profile. Origin = centre of cranium; ≈450×540 at s=1 (neck bottom y=+330, nose tip x=+246).
```ts
<HeadProfile x y s? facing?:'right'|'left' skin?=C.skin[1] skinShade? showBrain? highlight? highlightColor? hp?
  lobes? signal? eeg? implant? t? o? />
```
`showBrain` = cut-away with Brain (highlight/hp/signal/lobes pass through). Without the brain, `highlight`
glows on the skull. `eeg` = dark cap with electrodes + mesh + cable (electrodes flicker plum with `t`).
`implant` = electrode array on the motor cortex, wire to a skull pedestal with cable (LED pulses with `t`).
```tsx
<HeadProfile x={700} y={560} s={1.1} showBrain implant highlight="motor" hp={ramp(t,1,2)} signal={ramp(t,2,4)} t={t} />
<HeadProfile x={1300} y={560} facing="left" eeg skin={C.skin[3]} t={t} />
```

## ElectrodeArray · Electrode
Utah-style micro-electrode array, 3/4 view, origin = plate top centre, ≈130×90 at s=1 (needles hang down,
gold ribbon wire goes up-right). `Electrode` = single EEG disc (r≈14), `active` 0→1 glows plum.
```ts
<ElectrodeArray x y s? r? n?=6 t? active?=0 wire?=true />
<Electrode x y s? active? color?=C.theoryLight />
```

## BodyOutline
Front-view human figure with toggleable organs. Origin = between the feet; ≈310×700 at s=1.
```ts
<BodyOutline x y s? t? p?=1 organs?: {lungs?, heart?, brain?, stomach?, blood?: boolean | 0→1} fill?=C.paperDeep
  shade?=C.paperDark bpm?=72 o2?=1 />
```
`t` drives breathing (4 s cycle), heartbeat and blood flow (oxblood near the heart → plum at extremities).
`o2` < 1 greys the lungs (oxygen deprivation).
```tsx
<BodyOutline x={960} y={1000} s={1.25} t={t} p={ramp(t,0,1)} organs={{lungs: ramp(t,1,1.6), heart: true, blood: ramp(t,1.5,3)}} />
```

## Lungs · Heart
`Lungs`: front view with trachea + bronchial tree; origin = centre, ≈240×300 (trachea top y=−175).
`Heart`: anatomical-friendly with aorta (oxblood), vena cava + pulmonary trunk (plum); origin = centre, ≈200×260.
```ts
<Lungs x y s? breath?=0.5 (0→1 inflate) o2?=1 color?=C.oxTint airway?=C.paperLight o? />
<Heart x y s? t? bpm?=72 beat? (override 0→1) color?=C.oxLight o? />
```
```tsx
<Lungs x={700} y={540} breath={0.5 + 0.5*Math.sin(t*1.6)} o2={1 - ramp(t,3,6)} />
<Heart x={1200} y={540} s={1.2} t={t} bpm={110} />
```

## BloodVessel
Tube along a smooth path with flowing blood cells; colour shifts from `from` (start) to `to` (end).
```ts
<BloodVessel points: [x,y][] t? speed?=90 width?=26 from?=C.oxblood to?=C.oxblood wall?=C.oxTint p?=1 density?=1 seed? />
```
```tsx
<BloodVessel points={[[200,700],[600,560],[1000,640],[1700,500]]} t={t} width={40} from={C.oxblood} to={C.theory} p={ramp(t,0,1)} />
```

## Eye · EyeCrossSection
`Eye`: front view with lids, origin = centre, ≈330×200. `look` [-1..1, -1..1], `blink` 0 open → 1 closed,
`pupil` 0 pinpoint → 1 dilated. `frame` draws the skin lid patch.
`EyeCrossSection`: side cut, light enters from the right; origin = eyeball centre, R=150 (optic nerve to x=−250).
`rays` 0→1 draws light focusing on the fovea. Children render inside the vitreous (local coords, clipped
to r=126) — e.g. patrolling `ImmuneCell`s.
```ts
<Eye x y s? look?=[0,0] blink?=0 pupil?=0.45 iris?=C.evidenceLight skin?=C.skin[1] frame?=true />
<EyeCrossSection x y s? rays?=0 labels?=false labelP?=1>{children}</EyeCrossSection>
```
```tsx
<EyeCrossSection x={960} y={540} s={1.6} rays={ramp(t,1,2.5)} labels labelP={ramp(t,2,3)}>
  <ImmuneCell x={-40 + t*8} y={60} s={0.4} t={t} heading={0} />
</EyeCrossSection>
```

## Neuron · Synapse
`Neuron`: soma + tapered dendrites + myelinated axon pointing right + terminal bulbs. Origin = soma centre;
≈(length+80)×330. `signal` 0→1 = plum action potential down the axon (myelin segments light up, terminals flash at the end).
`Synapse`: presynaptic bulb (top) with vesicles; `p` 0→1 = one release, plum neurotransmitter crosses the
cleft and lights the green receptors. Origin = cleft centre, ≈340×460.
```ts
<Neuron x y s? r? length?=560 signal? seed?=3 color?=C.oxTint o? />
<Synapse x y s? p?=0 t? color?=C.oxTint />
```
```tsx
<Neuron x={300} y={540} s={1.4} signal={ramp(t,1,2.5,ease.linear)} />
```

## Cell · ImmuneCell
`Cell`: membrane wobbles with `t`; nucleus, mitochondria, ER, vesicles. Origin = centre, r=110.
`tone`: 'healthy' (green) | 'stressed' (mustard) | 'neutral' (paper).
`ImmuneCell`: macrophage-style blob with pseudopods reaching toward `heading` (deg, 0 = right), lobed nucleus,
granules. Origin = centre, r≈70 (+pseudopods). Move it yourself (x/y from t); `t` animates the body.
```ts
<Cell x y s? t? seed? tone?='healthy' r?=110 />
<ImmuneCell x y s? t? heading?=0 seed? color?=C.evidenceTint membrane?=C.evidenceLight />
```

## Germ · Bacterium · Virus
Caution mustard by default. `Germ kind`: 'rod' (bacillus + flagellum) | 'coccus' (grape cluster, count by seed)
| 'spiral' | 'virus' (spiked capsid). Origin = centre, ≈130–160 at s=1. `seed` = pose, `t` = wiggle/spin.
```ts
<Germ x y s? kind?='rod' seed? t? color? shade? />   // Bacterium / Virus take the same props
```

## DNA
Double helix along x (rotate with `r`). Origin = centre; `length` × 2·`radius`. Ink backbones (back strand
faint), base-pair rungs in four palette colours. `t` spins, `p` builds left → right.
```ts
<DNA x y s? r? length?=560 radius?=56 pitch?=230 t? p?=1 speed?=1.2 seed? backbone?=C.inkLift />
```

## Molecule
Ball-and-stick: 'O2' | 'CO2' | 'H2O' | 'CO' | 'N2' (O oxblood, C ink, H paper, N plum). Origin = centre.
`r` + `t·spin` rotate; `label` prints the formula (O₂) below; `p` pops it in.
```ts
<Molecule x y s? kind?='O2' r?=0 t? spin?=0 label?=false p?=1 />
```

## Waveform
Scrolling signal line; origin = left end of the baseline, `w` wide, ±`amp`.
kind: 'speech' (syllable bursts, ink) | 'eeg' (plum) | 'ecg' (oxblood heartbeat) | 'flat' (flatline). `p` draws on.
```ts
<Waveform x y w?=400 amp?=50 t? freq?=1 kind?='eeg' color? width?=4 p?=1 seed? speed?=140 />
```
```tsx
<Waveform x={300} y={800} w={1300} amp={80} t={t} kind={t < 5 ? 'ecg' : 'flat'} />
```

---

## Silhouettes (`kit/silhouette` + `tools/silhouette.mjs`) — shared library of free organism shapes
Animals, dinosaurs, humans, plants, microbes as clean single-colour vector shapes (PhyloPic, free licences only, credits
automatic). The library in `src/assets/silhouettes/` is SHARED by all videos — check it first, add to it when needed.
- `node tools/silhouette.mjs list` (what exists) · `search "canis lupus"` (→ `.cache/silhouettes/search.png`) · `get <#> --as wolf`
  Search works best with scientific names; check the result's title — PhyloPic may return a close relative.
- `Silhouette {name, x, y, h, color=ink, fill=true, outline:'none'|'solid'|'dashed', outlineColor, strokeWidth=4, p, reveal:'fade'|'wipe'|'rise'|'pop', flip, rot, o, anchor:'bottom'|'center'}`
  origin = bottom-centre (default). `outline="dashed" fill={false}` = Binly grammar for inferred / reconstructed / absent.
  `<Silhouette name="trex" x={1200} y={900} h={420} color={C.oxblood} reveal="wipe" p={ramp(t, T.rex, T.rex + 1)} />`
- `SILHOUETTE_NAMES` — names in the library. Unknown name → visible dashed "missing silhouette" box (fetch it).
Combine with kit parts: walk a silhouette across a Landscape (move x over time), scale comparisons with a Person,
dashed flesh over a skeleton, a Crowd of the same animal (several Silhouettes with seeded offsets).

# templates — `src/kit/templates.tsx` (shot templates)

**Use templates for standard beats; hand-craft the hook, reveals and signature moments.**

Each template is a finished full-frame shot (`<Stage>`), a pure function of absolute `t`, for a shot living from
`a` to `b` (s). Entrances key off cue props (`at`, `cues`, `…At`; default ≈ `a + 0.2`), holds stay alive (camera
push + breathe, dust, slow rings), and everything settles before `b` so any `<Shots>` transition works.
Common props (`ShotBase`): `t a b tone?: 'paper'|'ink'|'shade' seed? motif?: 'rings'|'band'|'frame'|'dots'|'none'`
— `seed` varies backdrop motif, camera drift and small layout choices (vary it between shots).
Gallery: `{"page":"templates"}` (stills 2.5, 5.5 … 29.5) and `{"page":"templates2"}` (2.5, 5.5 = Process, Question).
Helpers exported: `ShotShell` (stage + camera + backdrop + dust + vignette, for custom shots that should match),
`RichText` (wrapped text with words/type/fade reveal + marker/underline `mark` words + `strike` red-pen progress), `tonePal`, `semColor`, `Backdrop`, `shotCam`.

## TitleShot
Chapter/section title: kicker + big title (`\n` = 2 lines) + icon medallion, giant numeral, or custom art slot. Default tone ink.
```ts
<TitleShot {...base} title kicker? sub? icon?: IconName number?: '02' accent?: string[] at? layout?: 'center'|'left'
  children?: slot art (origin = slot centre, ≈380×340) />
```
```tsx
{start: T.c2, render: (t) => <TitleShot t={t} a={T.c2} b={T.s1} kicker="Chapter two" title="The bath that cured nothing" icon="bath" accent={['nothing']} at={T.c2 + 0.2}/>}
```

## StatShot
One exact number made tangible (counts up, lands exactly; oxblood beat). Optional comparison on the other half.
```ts
<StatShot {...base} value: '26' unit? label? kicker? note? icon? color? count?=true at? compareAt?
  compare?: {kind:'dots', filled, total?=100, cols?, color?, caption?}
          | {kind:'bars', bars: Bar[], highlight?, caption?}
          | {kind:'scale', items: {label, value, display?, icon?, color?}[2–3], caption?} />
```
```tsx
<StatShot t={t} a={T.s} b={T.e} value="26" unit="%" label="of patients recovered" at={T.num}
  compare={{kind:'dots', filled:26, caption:'26 out of every 100'}} compareAt={T.dots}/>
```

## QuoteShot
Quote or document excerpt. style `card` (paper card, big quote mark) · `document` (aged page, camera leans in) · `typed` (types with caret, ink).
```ts
<QuoteShot {...base} text source? sub? style?='card' highlight?: string[] at? highlightAt? revealDur? docTitle? />
```
```tsx
<QuoteShot t={t} a={T.q} b={T.r} style="document" docTitle="Report to the King · 1348" text="…the pestilence enters the body."
  highlight={['pestilence']} highlightAt={T.pest} source="Paris Medical Faculty"/>
```

## EvidenceShot
Real archival image framed on a gallery wall (wires, lamp light); camera pushes to the marked detail.
```ts
<EvidenceShot {...base} slug src credit? caption? aspect?=1.6 (img w/h) width? frame?: 'museum'|'print' tint?='paper'
  pan?: {from:[fx,fy,z], to:[fx,fy,z]}  mark?: {rx, ry, rw, rh, at?, shape?, label?}
  tag?: {text, kind?: Sem, at?}  nameTag?: {name, sub?, at?}  at? />   // default tone shade; ink = dark gallery
```
```tsx
<EvidenceShot t={t} a={T.ev} b={T.n} slug="medieval-baths" src="img/tournai.jpg" aspect={801/482} caption="Burial of plague victims, Tournai, 1349"
  credit="Pierart dou Tielt · Public domain" mark={{rx:0.32, ry:0.55, rw:0.3, rh:0.48, at:T.coffins, label:'Coffins'}} tag={{text:'Primary source'}}/>
```
`mark` coords = 0..1 of the window at zoom 1; the default pan zooms around the mark so it stays on the detail.

## ClaimShot
A claim with its certainty: confirmed (solid green frame) · theory (dashed plum = inferred) · caution (mustard). Optional verdict + "But…" line.
Verdict default 'pen': the claim is crossed out in red (not for confirmed) and `stamp` text is handwritten in the corner.
```ts
<ClaimShot {...base} text kind?: 'confirmed'|'theory'|'caution' tag? (default Confirmed/Theory/Debated) stamp? but?
  icon? highlight?: string[] at? tagAt? stampAt? butAt? />
```
```tsx
<ClaimShot t={t} a={T.c} b={T.d} kind="theory" text="Hot water spread the plague through open pores." highlight={['open','pores']}
  but="No one had yet seen a single germ." butAt={T.but} stamp="Wrong" stampAt={T.wrong}/>
```

## CompareShot
A vs B: `columns` (two cards + VS) · `venn` (overlap + side lists) · `balance` (scale tips to the verdict side).
```ts
type CompareSide = {title; bullets?: string[] (≤3, short); kind?: Sem; icon?; value?; weight? (balance blocks)}
<CompareShot {...base} left right mode?='columns' overlap? kicker? title? at? rightAt?
  verdict?: {text, side?: 'left'|'right'|'both', kind?: Sem, at?} />
```
```tsx
<CompareShot t={t} a={T.a} b={T.b} left={{title:'Miasma', icon:'wind', kind:'theory', bullets:['Bad air from rot']}}
  right={{title:'Germ theory', icon:'germ', kind:'confirmed', bullets:['Living microbes']}} rightAt={T.germ} verdict={{text:'Microbes win', side:'right', kind:'confirmed', at:T.win}}/>
```

## ListShot
2–5 items revealed on cues. `tiles` = icon medallions in a row; `column` = numbered rows + big medallion of the latest item (or `children` at 1440,560).
```ts
type ListItem = {label; icon?; sub?; kind?: Sem}
<ListShot {...base} items kicker? title? layout?='tiles' numbered?=true cues?: number[] at? gap?=0.7 highlight?: index highlightAt? children? />
```
```tsx
<ListShot t={t} a={T.l} b={T.m} title="More than a wash" items={[{label:'Hot water', icon:'drop'}, {label:'Gossip', icon:'speech'}]}
  cues={[T.water, T.gossip]} highlight={1} highlightAt={T.gossip + 2}/>
```

## TimelineShot
Events on cues while an oxblood cursor travels the axis; cards on two tiers; `eras` tint columns + labelled strip.
```ts
<TimelineShot {...base} from to events: {year, label, at?, kind?: Sem, yearLabel?, tier?: 0|1}[]
  eras?: {from, to, label, color?}[] ticks? format? kicker? title? at? gap?=0.8 />
```
```tsx
<TimelineShot t={t} a={T.tl} b={T.x} from={1200} to={1700} ticks={100} title="From cure to culprit"
  eras={[{from:1347, to:1550, label:'Plague years', color:C.oxblood}]} events={[{year:1348, label:'Black Death', kind:'signal', at:T.bd}]}/>
```
With `eras`, tick labels are hidden (the strip + cursor pill carry the years). Labels ≤ ~22 chars.

## MapShot
One GeoMap with pins / cities / spread rings, routes, areas, country highlights on cues. `side` layout = map + title column with a growing legend; `full` = full-bleed + title plate.
```ts
<MapShot {...base} region pins?: {lon, lat, label?, sub?, at?, kind?: 'pin'|'city'|'spread', side?, color?}[]
  routes?: {points: LonLat[], at?, dashed?, color?, bend?}[] areas?: {lon, lat, rx, ry?, rot?, label?, at?, color?}[]
  highlight?: (MapHighlight & {at?})[] labels? borders? kicker? title? sub? layout?='side' at? gap? />
```
```tsx
<MapShot t={t} a={T.m} b={T.n} region="western-europe" title="The plague reaches the baths"
  pins={[{lon:9.19, lat:45.46, label:'Milan', at:T.milan}, {lon:2.35, lat:48.86, label:'Paris', at:T.paris}]} routes={[{points:[[9.19,45.46],[2.35,48.86]], at:T.route, dashed:true}]}/>
```
Heavy to render locally (≈1–2 s/frame): one map per shot.

## PersonShot
Real-person intro: Person in a small environment + NameTag plate (kicker inside), optional held icon prop.
```ts
<PersonShot {...base} name sub? kicker? person?: Partial<PersonProps> env?: 'room'|'study'|'lab'|'street'|'museum'|'plain'
  era?: RoomEra ('modern' → modern lab/street) night? side?: 'left'|'right' prop?: IconName at? nameAt? children? (props behind the person) />
```
```tsx
<PersonShot t={t} a={T.p} b={T.q} name="Guy de Chauliac" sub="Papal physician · Avignon · 1348" env="study"
  person={{outfit:'robe', hat:'scholar', beard:'short'}} prop="book" nameAt={T.name}/>
```

## ProcessShot
Cause → effect on cues: `chain` (medallions + drawing arrows, a pulse runs the chain on the hold) or `cycle` (ring, labels outside, `center` text).
```ts
type ProcessStep = {label; icon?; kind?: Sem; sub?}
<ProcessShot {...base} steps mode?='chain' kicker? title? center? cues? at? gap?=0.6 />
```
```tsx
<ProcessShot t={t} a={T.p} b={T.q} title="Why baths seemed deadly" cues={[T.hot, T.pores, T.air, T.plague]}
  steps={[{label:'Hot water', icon:'drop'}, {label:'Pores open', icon:'thermometer'}, {label:'Bad air enters', icon:'wind', kind:'theory'}, {label:'Plague', icon:'skull'}]}/>
```

## QuestionShot
Open question / curiosity pivot: big question (accent words) + slot: `?`, dashed `silhouette`, or your art. Default tone ink.
```ts
<QuestionShot {...base} question kicker? highlight?: string[] mark?: 'question'|'silhouette'|'none' at? markAt? side?='right'
  children? (slot art, origin = slot centre, ≈520×520) />
```
```tsx
<QuestionShot t={t} a={T.q} b={T.r} question="So who actually carried the plague into the bathhouse?" highlight={['carried']} mark="silhouette"/>
```

---

# kit/transport — vehicles

`import {Ship, Cart, Train, Car, Horse} from '../kit/transport'`. Flat, upper-left light, palette only.
All vehicles face **right** (`flip` for left); origin = **ground / waterline under the body centre**.
Shared props: `{x, y, s?, flip?, t?, tone?: Tone, color?, moving?: bool}` — `moving` + `t` turn on motion
(wheels turn, horse walks, sails billow, smoke puffs, boats bob + wake); `tone` re-tints like env props.
Sizes at s=1 are big (≈300–600 wide): use s 0.4–0.8 in scenes. Pair with `Weather` (kit/fx) and env backgrounds.

- **Ship** — `{kind?: 'rowboat'|'sailing'|'steam'='sailing'}` · rowboat ~260 wide (oar rows) · sailing ~520, 2 masts, ~440 tall · steam ~580, funnel smoke. Put on `Water` with y = water top + ~15.
  `<Ship kind="sailing" x={900} y={800} s={0.6} t={t} moving/>`
- **Cart** — horse-drawn `{kind?: 'cart'|'wagon'|'carriage'='cart'; horse?=true}` · cart = 2-wheel open · wagon = covered 4-wheel · carriage = closed coach. Horse walks in front (+x ≈ 250 → total ≈ 520–620 wide).
  `<Cart kind="wagon" x={600} y={ENV_FLOOR} s={0.7} t={t} moving/>`
- **Train** — `{kind?: 'steam'|'modern'='steam'; cars?=2}` · loco ~400 wide, each coach +330 trailing behind (−x). steam: boiler, cab, drive rod, smoke; modern: streamlined nose, window band, red stripe.
  `<Train kind="steam" cars={3} x={1500} y={860} s={0.5} t={t} moving/>`
- **Car** — `{kind?: 'vintage'|'modern'='modern'}` · ~300 long · vintage (1910s–30s, spoked wheels, bounce, default green) · modern sedan (default slate).
- **Horse** — the cart horse alone, side view, ~260 long × 230 tall, walk cycle when `moving`. `{color?}`

Motion across the frame is the builder's job: animate `x` (e.g. `x={lerp(-300, 2200, ramp(t, 0, 8, ease.linear))}`) and pass `moving`.
